name: Screenlap
description: A ruled field laid over a solid one, both in the same ink, so the overlap doubles.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 16% 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: 0.55; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8% 16%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10% 20%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10% 20%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
